newsitem.title: UK: P&O shares fall amid bearish chart signs.
newsitem.headline: P&O shares fall amid bearish chart signs.

text.p: Shares in Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co fell seven pence to 660 pence amid bearish technical pointers which suggested futher short-term pressure, dealers said.

They added there were no fundamental reasons for the current weakness in P&O shares, which started falling to create a bearish double-top chart pattern at the 678 pence level with a neckline at about 660 pence over the past three weeks.

The share price peaks were accompanied by large turnover in the stock implying selling pressure around the 678 pence level. A close below neckline support in the near-term would indicate P&O might fall another 20 pence before hitting chart support again, analysts said.
